title: Storm Drain Inlets
description: Storm Drain Inlets in Sandy City, Utah. The upstream service publishes no description for this layer. 12,312 point features, mirrored as GeoParquet in EPSG:3566 (NAD83(HARN) / Utah Central (ftUS)) with Web Mercator vector tiles for display. See the [agent guide](AGENTS.md) for the schema, the coded-value lists and queries that run.
